name: Helena Imagine Bridge Prompt Standard
goal: 초A급 포토그래퍼·시네마 스틸. 키워드 나열이 아니라 한 장면의 산문. 페이지 재래스터 금지 — 브릿지·무드만.

brand_lock.feel: dark luxury editorial webzine · quiet hope · care + aspiration
never: readable UI text or fake logos

prompt_craft_rules: Subject first sentence. One coherent scene only.
Natural prose 3–5 sentences. Not comma-keyword soup.
Order: subject → action/pose → setting → style → composition → lighting/mood → 1–2 material details.
No readable brand words on the image — emotion and light carry meaning.
Photographer language: lens feel, light quality, depth, grade — not '4k ultra detailed masterpiece' spam.
Animation-friendly: one clear hero subject, soft background, avoid fine text and dense geometry if later I2V.

quality_bar_v1.looks_like: A24 title card meets luxury product still, not midjourney default sludge
pass_if: shallow depth or painterly soft falloff

canon_prompts_v1.b_open_hook: A single modern smartphone floats upright in absolute darkness the color of charcoal paper, its edge catching a thin ribbon of molten gold light like candlelight on metal. Soft teal dust motes drift in the void around it, almost still. Shot as a vertical 9:16 luxury product still — medium close, centered, shallow depth of field, background dissolving into black. Mood is quiet power and invitation, the first breath of a premium tech webzine film; photoreal materials, restrained, gallery-worthy.
canon_prompts_v1.b_close_handoff: In near-black space, a warm gold wax seal of light hovers above an open palm and a darkened smartphone resting on dark rag paper, teal ambient pooling at the edges like deep water. Vertical 9:16 cinematic still, low three-quarter angle, soft volumetric glow without glare, film grain barely there. Mood is solemn hope and release — a handoff, not a sale; elegant, spiritual quiet, no text, museum print quality.

iteration.next: v1.1 after Boss visual score on open/close pair
iteration.method: keep winning stills as reference; image_edit for variants; never regenerate both cold without anchor

paths.active_symlink_style: copy winning stills to bridge/b_open.jpg and b_close.jpg for pipeline
